ops.body:
FIELD RESULTS from the first v0.20.8 convergence attempt (local machine, captain-hook 12.20.11) — the fix SPLITS:

WORKS: applyRolledBack recovery — the rolled-back receipt from three failed reinstalls superseded cleanly, zero ErrInstallConflict, postinstall progressed to the agent-install stage. Field-confirmed.

DOES NOT FIX LOCAL BOOTSTRAP: keyless agents are demonstrably live (the EIO diagnostic now reads desired session "unrestricted" — daemonkit rendering the empty field) and bootstrap STILL failed EIO 5 after 6 attempts. FALSIFIER: the exact same keyless plist (untouched, same mtime) bootstraps exit-0 instantly by hand. The only variable is the CALLER. This kills the fourth plist-content mechanism and exposes a CONFOUND running through the entire evidence base: every successful bootstrap ever recorded (local 01:51, home's verdict, the sleep test) was a manual launchctl call; every failure came through daemonkit's install path. Key-removal and caller-change were never separated in any test.

STANDING MODEL: two cells, at most one key-driven. Home's cell (Background key + SSH + fresh label) gets its decisive keyless-via-daemonkit test when home converges on synckit v0.36.3. Local's cell is caller/timing-shaped — leading hypothesis: reload()'s bootout→bootstrap against a just-terminated GUI .app outlasts the ~6.2s total retry budget (200ms×2^n, 6 attempts), so every attempt hits a still-terminating label; both manual successes ran against long-absent labels. Falsification test authorized and running: bootout → 90s settle → brew postinstall (daemonkit caller, long-absent label), which doubles as the 12.20.11 delivery attempt since app delivery gates behind this step (dc97d32). Reinstall guard RE-IMPOSED on the local machine except this one deliberate test; the failed reload booted out the working helper mid-attempt (regression caused and repaired by the lane — helper restored manually, pid 48412).

Release scoreboard unchanged: daemonkit v0.20.8, fusekit v1.15.4, cc-notes v0.48.1, captain-hook v12.20.11 all published; synckit v0.36.3 tag pushed, Release workflow finishing. Criterion b613c1b9 (install completes without EIO on a previously-failing machine) remains PENDING — the local cell is not yet fixed by anything released.
